description: Generates EN 1990 bridge load combinations with the Eurocode Load Combinations plugin's engine (6.10 / 6.10a+b, SLS characteristic / frequent / quasi-permanent, accidental 6.11, seismic 6.12; Annex A2 ψ by bridge type; recommended, UK or Irish annex factors; leading-action and exclusive-alternative logic) and writes them to an LCOM table with its commit: the target is re-read first, every row is read back. Previews unless apply: true.

collapseExclusive.description: Combine exclusive alternatives into one envelope sub-combination (the plugin's default per relation).

existingHandling.description: Required when the target already holds combinations. Deleting only with the user's agreement.

includeEnvelopes.description: Also write one envelope per family (General only).

factors.description: Annex, bridge type and typed overrides (only finite numbers are taken).

groups.description: Advanced: the Groups & Relations state { groups, withinCategory, constraints }. Omit to build them automatically from the mapping, as the plugin does.

mapping.description: Changes to the mapping ec_combinations_read shows; only the rows to change. Rows match by caseId, else caseName (moving rows by charCaseName).

psiManual.description: ψ for a case without a Freq pair (user-defined vehicle).

subtype.description: Q: Traffic, BRK, Accel, CF, Wind, WL, TU, TG, Snow, Rain, Ice, EP, ES, Hydro, Other. Ad: IL, Impact.

scope.description: Default: ULS 6.10a + 6.10b only. UK and Irish annexes require 6.10 for bridges.

show.description: Which combinations to list in the preview (all are written).

name: ec_combinations_apply
title: Generate and write Eurocode load combinations
